table.retrieve:
SELECT
	I.customicode,
	itemname= I.name, 
	locksaleprice = I.locksaleprice,
	lockdiscperc  = I.lockdiscperc,
	currlistrow   = 0,
	stock         = 0.0000, 
	packingdesc=I.packingdesc,
	qtysale=I.saleqty,
	bonus=I.bonusqty,
	totalstock= 0.0000, 
	purprice=0.00,
	recentpurprice=0.00,
	avgprice=T.avgprice,
	itemtotalval=space(30),
	assgcode  = 1, 
	updatesaleprice = 'N',
	saleordercode=T.saleordercode,   
	icode=T.icode,   
	gcode=T.gcode,
	itemflatdisc = T.itemflatdisc,
	ROWID=T.RowID,
	packunits = T.packunits,
	saleprice = T.saleprice,
	rate      = T.rate,
	SaleItemDescription =  T.SaleItemDescription,
	discperc  = T.discperc,
	claimable= T.claimable,
	claimablediscperc= T.claimablediscperc,
	itemcode = 0,
	retailprice=I.retailprice,
	rowgroup=T.rowgroup,
	packprice = T.packprice,
	unitsalestax=T.unitsalestax,
	gstperc=T.gstperc,
	packqtyforsale = T.packqtyforsale, 
	bonuspackqtyforsale = T.bonuspackqtyforsale,
	remarks = T.remarks,
	SaleOrderItemStatusCode=T.SaleOrderItemStatusCode,
	QuotationRowID=T.QuotationRowID,
	bonusqty=T.bonusqty,
	looseqty= T.looseqty,
	saleqty = SUM(T.SaleQty),
	salebonus = SUM(T.salebonus)
FROM
	Item I,
	(SELECT 
		avgprice=SORD.avgprice,
		saleordercode=SORD.saleordercode,   
		icode=SORD.icode,   
		gcode=SORD.gcode,
		itemflatdisc = SORD.itemflatdisc,
		RowID=SORD.IDENTITYCOL,
		packunits = SORD.packunits,
		saleprice = SORD.saleprice,
		rate      = SORD.rate,
		SaleItemDescription =  SORD.SaleItemDescription,
		discperc  = SORD.discperc,
		claimable=SORD.claimable,
		claimablediscperc=SORD.claimablediscperc,
		rowgroup=SORD.rowgroup,
		packprice = SORD.packprice,
		unitsalestax=SORD.unitsalestax,
		gstperc=SORD.gstperc,
		packqtyforsale = SORD.packqtyforsale, 
		bonuspackqtyforsale = SORD.bonuspackqtyforsale,
		remarks = SORD.remarks,
		SaleOrderItemStatusCode=SORD.SaleOrderItemStatusCode,
		QuotationRowID=SORD.QuotationRowID,
		bonusqty=SORD.bonusqty,
		looseqty= SORD.looseqty,
		saleqty = CASE :ar_populationmethod WHEN 1 THEN ISNULL(sum(SD.LooseQty), 0) ELSE 0 END,
		salebonus = CASE :ar_populationmethod WHEN 1 THEN ISNULL(sum(SD.BonusQty), 0) ELSE 0 END
	FROM
		SaleOrderDetail SORD,
		SaleDetail SD
	WHERE 
		SORD.saleordercode IN (:ar_SaleOrderCode) AND
		SORD.rowid = SD.SaleOrderRowID
	GROUP BY
		SORD.saleordercode,   
		 SORD.gcode,
		SORD.icode,   
		SORD.itemflatdisc,
		SORD.IDENTITYCOL,
		SORD.packunits,
		SORD.saleprice,
		SORD.rate,
		SORD.SaleItemDescription,
		SORD.discperc,
		SORD.claimable,
		SORD.claimableDiscperc,
		SORD.rowgroup,
		SORD.packprice,
		SORD.unitsalestax,
		SORD.gstperc,
		SORD.packqtyforsale, 
		SORD.bonuspackqtyforsale,
		SORD.remarks,
		SORD.SaleOrderItemStatusCode,
		SORD.QuotationRowID,
		SORD.bonusqty,
		SORD.looseqty,
		SORD.avgprice
	UNION
	SELECT 
		avgprice=SORD.avgprice,
		saleordercode=SORD.saleordercode,   
		icode=SORD.icode,   
		 gcode=SORD.gcode,
		itemflatdisc = SORD.itemflatdisc,
		ROWID=SORD.IDENTITYCOL,
		packunits = SORD.packunits,
		saleprice = SORD.saleprice,
		rate      = SORD.rate,
		SaleItemDescription =  SORD.SaleItemDescription,
		discperc  = SORD.discperc,
		claimable=SORD.claimable,
		claimablediscperc=SORD.claimablediscperc,
		rowgroup=SORD.rowgroup,
		packprice = SORD.packprice,
		unitsalestax=SORD.unitsalestax,
		gstperc=SORD.gstperc,
		packqtyforsale = SORD.packqtyforsale, 
		bonuspackqtyforsale = SORD.bonuspackqtyforsale,
		remarks = SORD.remarks,
		SaleOrderItemStatusCode=SORD.SaleOrderItemStatusCode,
		QuotationRowID=SORD.QuotationRowID,
		bonusqty=SORD.bonusqty,
		looseqty= SORD.looseqty,
		saleqty = 0,
		salebonus = 0
	FROM
		SaleOrderDetail SORD
	WHERE 
		SORD.saleordercode IN (:ar_SaleOrderCode)) T
WHERE
	T.ICode = I.ICode
GROUP BY
	I.customicode, 
	I.name, 
	I.locksaleprice,
	I.lockdiscperc,
	I.packingdesc,
	I.saleqty,
	I.bonusqty,
	T.avgprice,
	T.saleordercode,   
	T.icode,   
	T.gcode,
	T.itemflatdisc,
	T.RowID,
	T.packunits,
	T.saleprice,
	T.rate,
	T.SaleItemDescription,
	T.discperc,
	T.claimable,
	T.claimablediscperc,
	I.retailprice,
	T.rowgroup,
	T.packprice,
	T.unitsalestax,
	T.gstperc,
	T.packqtyforsale, 
	T.bonuspackqtyforsale,
	T.remarks,
	T.SaleOrderItemStatusCode,
	T.QuotationRowID,
	T.Looseqty,
	T.BonusQty
ORDER BY
	RowID

objects.name: c_detaildwtotal
objects.expression: sum( ( ( looseqty *  (saleprice -  itemflatdisc )) ) *  ( 1-  (  discperc  *  .01 )  )  for all)

objects.name: c_sumtaxval
objects.expression: sum( round( unitsalestax  * (Bonusqty + looseqty) ,2)  for all)

objects.name: c_sumgstval
objects.expression: sum( round( c_itemtotal  *  gstperc * 0.01,2)  for all)
